# Resource asset fixture

Roboto regular latin and greek subsets in WOFF and WOFF2 are from
`@fontsource/roboto` 5.3.0, distributed under the included FONT-LICENSE.
Each format/subset is a separate source resource; they must not substitute for
one another. The tiny silent WebM was generated with ffmpeg from a blue frame.
The public capture test serves these files, a generated one-page PDF, a ZIP
containing a text file and a PNG poster on an ephemeral loopback HTTP origin.
